source: Arcane Table engine phrase table: whole English lines generated by Forge (keyword triggers, effect cards, prompts) that are not on any printed card. Digits are normalized to # when matching; # in a translation is filled with the original numbers in order. %0, %1 are free slots (card or player names, mana costs) copied into the translation. A trailing ' (Targeting: ...)', ' ([remembered])' or ' [trigger info]' is ignored when matching and appended back. Collected with java/forge-adapter/driver/localization-sweep.mjs.
